daily.today_energy: Mercury's whispering something real today, Scorpio. Your intuition is running hot—trust those gut feelings that make you pause. This is your moment to lean into that magnetic energy you've got brewing.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the shift in your vibe. Whether you're single or coupled up, authenticity is your love language right now. Don't perform; just be. The right people stay when you show up as yourself.
daily.career: Your ideas have teeth today. That project you've been sitting on? The energy supports bringing it forward. Your focus is sharp and your strategic thinking is unmatched. Keep building momentum.
daily.health: Your body's asking you to slow down just a little. Not rest—move with intention. A walk, stretching, or something grounding will recalibrate your whole system. Listen to what feels nourishing.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is calling you to get real with yourself, Scorpio. Mercury's influence has you questioning old narratives and honestly? It's the vibe. Trust your instincts—they're sharper than usual.
weekly.love: Whether single or coupled up, this is your week to communicate what's actually on your mind. Stop playing it cool. The universe is rewarding vulnerability, and someone's definitely listening more closely than you think.
weekly.career: Your creative energy is immaculate right now. If you've been sitting on an idea or waiting for the right moment, this is it. Channel that Scorpio intensity into making something happen. Small moves, big momentum.
